description: "Ainy" is a word provenient from the ancestral language "mapuche", that means, love, sharing, reciprocity... just as our idea of team is; we are two brothers wanting to innovate our previous ideas from the SpaceApp challenge 2025. As always, glad to be here and continue sharing and making connections with people.
summary:
We decided to develop this Project because we´ve seen an isssue with how the astronauts  spend their time in space, because there they can experiment things that can affect their physical and psicologycal  integrity.
This proyect uses a  visual stimuli to inform the user the possible issues he might be having; not too loud to be stressfull but neither too silent to not be noticed.
We created an AI assistant that features an Biometric engine that integrates important data in a way thats more accesible to the user, without turning out annoying or heavy.
It´s important this project because its an efficient solution to a very common issue in spacial missions.
details:
So, our team created a visual friendly software, Featuring an actual live engine that SIMULATES Biometric data in real time as colors; its framework its explained totally in our inform, the engine work is; track 6 variables that we considered are the most important on long space missions, ; their work is to prevent critical health issues and inform in a way that doesnt affect your workflow; the backend and engine is running a python; and the front end, node.js; vite.

Worked on a copilot/github environment, we were able to do this project from scratch. so digital design and creative ideas were worked from scratch from us just on us.

every litle explanation and decision is given on the PDF inform next to our presentation.

we say NASA powered, because the prompt engineer is trained on NASA protocols that we linked and explained furthermore on our inform.

We really think our project is creative because we considered and built a mechanic that changes he way how scientists and astrounauts manage their healt. and also makes a way o develop this software furthermore with More technology and more NASA datasets available.
